newsitem.title: UK: BAA higher on airport traffic figures.
newsitem.headline: BAA higher on airport traffic figures.

text.p: Shares in BAA Plc opened higher on Tuesday after the British airports operator said passenger traffic rose 5.5 percent in 1996 to 96.8 million and was up 7.8 percent in December compared with the same month last year.
"The passenger numbers were seen as fairly good and shares were marked up on the back of that," one market-maker said.
BAA shares were up 8-1/2p at 493-1/2 by 0830 GMT.
BAA was recently picked by analysts at both Lehman Brothers and NatWest Securities as one of the shares most likely to outperform in 1997.
